content.title: RealReal Stock Jumps on Higher Luxury Resale Demand
content.summary: Shares of The RealReal surged after the reseller of luxury goods reported strong quarterly sales and hiked its annual guidance.  Total revenue rose 17% last quarter and the company now expects annual revenue of $687 million to $690 million, versus prior guidance of $667 million to $674 million.  The RealReal has benefited from the luxury slowdown, as shoppers weary of price increases increasingly turn to previously owned goods.
